title: Befriend the Far, Attack the Near
era: Late Warring States · about 2,300 years ago

source.chapter: Befriend the Far, Attack the Near
source.quote: When position blocks and force constrains, profit is taken from the near and harm is kept far off. Fire above, marsh below.

moral: Order matters — settle the near first, and befriend the far ones first.
transfer: Finish today's work first, then play far away.
